builds.name: Snowball of Destruction
builds.desc: This is a pretty standard build for a speedy ranged unit. The difference with Ylgr is how blazing fast she can be at base. At neutral with her weapon active she can reach 45 speed with no merges, this speed allows her to invest heavily into attack. For consistency of her weapon effect, you may want to take a speed boon over an attack boon, but the rest of the build can be focused on attack. Flashing Blade can allow her to guarantee a Glimmer or Moonbow proc in desperation range.
